item.title: 60-Year Old Motorcyclist Dies After Traffic Challan In Gujrat

item.title: New Motorway Rule: Unsafe Vehicles to Be Stopped
item.description: Federal Minister Abdul Aleem Khan orders strict tyre fitness checks on all motorways following the M-9 crash. Vehicles with worn-out or expired tyres will be denied entry. The post New Motorway Rule: Unsafe Vehicles to Be Stopped appeared first on PakWheels Blog.
